description: Claude Code Observability Dashboard - Monitor usage, costs, and performance

panels.description: A session's very first cost sample inside this window can be undercounted (Prometheus increase() limitation).
panels.title: Cost (Last Hour)

panels.description: Sum of all token types including cacheRead, which usually dominates the total. Thresholds are a rough default; tune to your usage.
panels.title: Token Usage (1h)

panels.description: A session's very first cost sample inside this range can be undercounted (Prometheus increase() limitation).
panels.title: Cost (Selected Range)

panels.description: Mean cost per local day, over days that had spend, dropping days under 15% of the median day. Day boundaries use a fixed EST offset (19h); change it to 18h in EDT.
panels.title: Avg Cost / Day (all time)

panels.description: Mean of the rolling 7-day cost sums, evaluated daily over the last 30 days. Prometheus keeps 30 days, so the oldest windows are partial and pull the average down. Day boundaries use a fixed EST offset (19h); change it to 18h in EDT.
panels.title: Avg Cost / Week (30d)

panels.description: Seconds since the newest claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total sample reached Prometheus (looks back 7 days). Idle gaps are normal; hours of silence while you are using Claude Code mean the export path is broken. No data means nothing arrived in 7 days.
panels.title: Last Telemetry Received

panels.description: Trailing 1h cost per model, sampled at the graph's native resolution. Counters reset per session, so a session's very first cost sample inside a sampled window can be undercounted (Prometheus increase() limitation).
panels.title: Cost by Model (Hourly)

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~".*claude-code.*"} |= "claude_code.tool_result" | success="true" [15m]))) or (0 * sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~".*claude-code.*"} |= "claude_code.tool_result" [15m])))) / (sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~".*claude-code.*"} |= "claude_code.tool_result" [15m])))

panels.description: Trailing 1h commit/PR count, sampled at the graph's native resolution. A session's first commit/PR inside a sampled window can be undercounted (Prometheus increase() limitation).
panels.title: Development Activity (Hourly)

panels.description: Trailing 24h cost burn rate against a budget line set by the $budget_per_day dashboard variable (top of page). The background thresholds below are still fixed at $10/$20; edit them separately if you change the budget far from $20/day. Add a real Grafana alert rule on this query if you want paging instead of a visual line.
panels.title: 🚨 Cost Rate vs Budget Threshold

panels.description: Cache hit rate across all sessions: cacheRead tokens as a share of total prompt-side tokens (cacheRead + cacheCreation + input), 5m rate window.
panels.title: Cache Hit Rate (All Sessions)

panels.description: Cost by skill, across all sessions in range. With OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 (v2.1.273+), skill_name carries the real skill name. Without it, third-party marketplace skills are redacted to the literal string "third-party" (built-in/bundled/user-defined/official-marketplace skills always show real names). Absent skill_name shows as "direct" (no skill active). Uses increase() over the full selected range, so a session's very first cost sample can be undercounted (same Prometheus limitation as the other range-total panels).
panels.title: Cost by Skill (Selected Range)

panels.description: Cost by MCP server + tool, across all sessions in range. Legend is "server: tool" (mcp_server.name / mcp_tool.name labels on the cost metric). Filtered to series where mcp_tool_name is set, so only covers tool calls routed through MCP servers — built-in tools (Read, Edit, Bash, etc.) carry no tool_name on this metric and cannot be split out. User-configured MCP servers show as "custom" unless OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 (v2.1.273+). Uses increase() over the full selected range, so a session's very first cost sample can be undercounted.
panels.title: Cost by MCP Tool (Selected Range)

panels.description: pdca:* phases (plan/do/check/act/cycle) rolled into one "pdca" bucket. pdlc includes an agent_name=~"pdlc-.*" fallback because the pdlc-developer-agent subagent never sets skill_name, so skill_name="pdlc" alone undercounts pdlc by roughly 90%. Uses increase() over $__range (same first-sample caveat as other range-total panels).

targets.expr: sum by (skill) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{job="otel-collector", skill_name=~"pdca.*"}[$__range]), "skill", "pdca", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{job="otel-collector", skill_name="pdlc"}[$__range]), "skill", "pdlc", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{job="otel-collector", agent_name=~"pdlc-.*", skill_name=""}[$__range]), "skill", "pdlc", "", ""))

panels.title: Cost by Skill — pdca/pdlc Normalized (Selected Range)

panels.description: Same normalized pdca/pdlc rollup, split by query_source (main session vs subagent fan-out). Shows how much of each skill's cost comes from spawned subagents.

targets.expr: sum by (skill, query_source) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{job="otel-collector", skill_name=~"pdca.*"}[$__range]), "skill", "pdca", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{job="otel-collector", skill_name="pdlc"}[$__range]), "skill", "pdlc", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{job="otel-collector", agent_name=~"pdlc-.*", skill_name=""}[$__range]), "skill", "pdlc", "", ""))

panels.title: pdca vs pdlc Cost: Main vs Subagent

panels.description: pdlc subagent cost split by agent_name (pdlc-developer-agent does the TDD work, pdlc-quality-agent reviews). Filters on agent_name directly since skill_name is unreliable on these subagent rows.
panels.title: PDLC Cost by Agent (Selected Range)

list.description: Budget line for the Cost Rate vs Budget Threshold panel, in $/day. A fixed preset list (not free text) so a bad value can't break the panel's vector($budget_per_day) query.
list.label: Budget ($/day)
list.name: budget_per_day
